scope.summary: Plan a development-time five-run real Codex single-Agent cohort that measures native event compatibility, governed reason codes, and actually observed human review friction without adding RepoPilot runtime integration.
non_goals: No modification or integration of app runtime, public API, CLI, ToolRegistry, provider defaults, persistence, or existing supervision kernel.
No fake, synthetic, archived, subagent, or reviewer output may count as a real cohort run or human review input.
No durable operator identity, AI-authored human decision, daemon, background worker, runtime subagent, multi-Agent flow, notification, retry, or automatic repair.
No Agent access to RepoPilot or user-project roots, task secrets/provider credentials; no task-side network, arbitrary controller argv, danger bypass, add-dir, or Agent Git delivery.
No product completion, semantic correctness, verified provenance, provider-wide compatibility, product acceptance, release readiness, or Git delivery claim.
No modification of archived qualification artifacts, the qualification validator, long-term specs, or the original dirty worktree.
No real run may launch under workspace-write alone; host-owned fixture-only read/write and whole-process-tree containment evidence is required.
No real Agent launch, controller implementation, cohort result, archive, commit, merge, or push in this authority epoch.
